text:
maya_support: heads up — customer on Dedicated reported stream decode failures in our Go SDK when using chunked responses. They see intermittent JSON errors and dropped events. app: acme-checkout, request id: r-9f3a

alex_devex: can you paste the logs / a minimal repro?

maya_support: logs show repeated errors like:
```
2026-03-12T10:14:02Z error: json: invalid character '}' looking for beginning of object
2026-03-12T10:14:02Z debug: received chunk: "{\"event\":\"start\"}\n"
2026-03-12T10:14:02Z debug: received chunk: "{\"event\":\"line_item\" ... partial..."
```

sam_eng: this screams buffer/scan boundary issues. bufio.Scanner defaults to 64K max token. if a single JSON object or compressed chunk >64K you get truncated pieces and weird errors. are we using a Scanner anywhere in the SDK client?

alex_devex: historically we had a scanner-based fallback for delimited streams. but the SDK should use a streaming json.Decoder for object streams. i'll check the client code path.

lina_infra: fwiw i reproduced locally with an nginx upstream retry + chunked encoding. when the gateway retries it can write back-to-back chunks (no delimiter) and downstream readers that expect newline-delimited frames see `}{` concatenation. repro steps i used:
1) simple upstream that returns two JSON objects in separate write() calls (~80KB each)
2) nginx with `proxy_next_upstream` enabled and `chunked_transfer_encoding on`
3) our Go client that uses `bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)` to read tokens
results: scanner yields broken tokens when a chunk boundary splits a JSON token.

maya_support: i attached a minimal Go repro to the customer; snippet below (buggy):
```go
// buggy: uses Scanner which will break on large tokens
resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
    line := scanner.Text()
    var obj map[string]interface{}
    json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &obj)
    fmt.Println(obj)
}
```

sam_eng: yep. that code will fail for big frames and when chunks aren't newline terminated. two fixes: increase buffer with `scanner.Buffer()` (band-aid) or switch to `json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)` and `Decode()` in a loop which tolerates split reads. also consider length-prefixed framing or an explicit newline protocol.

alex_devex: digging into the SDK — customer is on go-sdk v0.12.1. i found a path where the stream reader falls back to a scanner for some CLI-style streaming endpoints. there's also a bug where gateway retries were concatenating frames without separators causing `}{` to appear.

lina_infra: i opened a patch to prefer `json.Decoder` and add a robust boundary handler + unit tests for chunk boundaries (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/482). patch avoids Scanner unless the stream is explicitly newline-delimited.

maya_support: what's the recommended customer action right now? they want a quick mitigation because it's affecting orders.

alex_devex: short-term mitigations:
- upgrade to go-sdk v0.12.3 (contains the patch) — recommended
- if they can't upgrade immediately: disable gateway automatic retries for that route (nginx: `proxy_next_upstream off`) or ensure upstream emits a newline after each JSON object
- temporary client workaround: replace Scanner code with `json.Decoder` in their consumer if they manage the client app

sam_eng: for reference, fixed code pattern (server-safe):
```go
dec := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)
for {
    var msg map[string]interface{}
    if err := dec.Decode(&msg); err == io.EOF {
        break
    } else if err != nil {
        log.Printf("decode err: %v", err)
        break
    }
    handle(msg)
}
```

deploy-bot: release v0.12.3 -> canary deployed to hosted (tag: v0.12.3, sha: a1b2c3d)

maya_support: thanks — i've asked the customer to try v0.12.3 and to disable retries as a stopgap. i'll follow up once they confirm.

alex_devex: also adding a support KB note linking the PR + mitigation steps. will schedule a Dedicated roll for next maintenance window if customer prefers the Managed patch.

lina_infra: logging follow-up: we should add an observability metric for "stream framing mismatches" so we can detect these patterns earlier (error string matching: "invalid character '}' looking for beginning of object" + repeated short bursts). filing infra ticket.

maya_support: perfect. i'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
